column1: # GENERATION: pack(data, tmpl) (G8 phase 1,
# docs/capability-review/g8-generation.md). One child of the result map
# per child of `data`, each of them `tmpl` cloned at the destination.
# Columns: name<TAB>mode<TAB>src<TAB>expect
# KEYS ARE DATA, NOT POSITION: for a list the strings themselves are
# the keys, for a map its keys. A non-string list element is refused
# (`pack_key`) rather than keyed by its index — Terraform's `count`,
# keyed by position, churns every downstream child when a list is
# reordered, which is why keying by data replaced it as best practice.
# Duplicate generated keys are NOT an error: the colliding children
# unify, exactly as duplicate source keys already merge (map.tsv).
# UNFIRED, a generator canons as its CALL, which reparses to the same
# value — so canon convergence holds for a model that has not finished.
# Reaching that state takes data that never settles (`1+true` below is
# the stuck operation budget.tsv uses), because a generator whose data
# settles fires.
pack-list
pack-list-canon
pack-map
pack-map-canon
pack-duplicate-keys-merge
pack-empty-list
pack-empty-map
pack-literal-list
pack-ref-template
pack-pref-override
pack-override-conflict
pack-ref-into-generated
pack-nested
# FLIPPED 2026-08-26 (spread application rework): the data argument
# snapshots only a SETTLED source (Ctx.argsnap / RefVal.find), so an
# unfired generator over a stuck source canons with the reference still
# standing. See the twin note in gen-each.tsv. Parity-probed 2026-08-26.
pack-unfired-canon
pack-unfired-errc
pack-literal-key-canon
pack-data-integer
pack-data-string
pack-data-kind
pack-key-integer
pack-key-mixed
pack-key-map
pack-arity-one
pack-arity-none
pack-arity-three
# TEMPLATE-CLONE ISOLATION (ADR-005, 2026-08-26; use-cases/BUGS.md §9):
# a rank-2 default computed from key() shared its one inner key()
# across the generated children (the pref clone shared its inner
# value), so every child silently answered the FIRST child's key. Rank
# 1 escaped only because its meet builds a fresh pref per destination;
# both ranks are now full per-destination instances. The override row
# composes with the admission gate (ADR-004): `zz` is admitted by the
# string alternative. Parity-probed in both engines.
pack-rankpref-key-per-child
pack-rankpref-key-override
# EXPRESSIONS IN A TEMPLATE RE-ANCHOR PER CHILD (ADR-005, 2026-08-26;
# use-cases/BUGS.md §33): a relative reference or key() nested inside
# a `+` expression or a call argument used to resolve at the
# TEMPLATE's own location (visible as the NaN path segment in the
# no_path diagnostics), while the same reference as a bare value
# re-anchored correctly. The per-destination instance now has every
# inner path normalised to the destination (repathInstance / the Go
# setPaths call), so the expression forms answer for the child
# exactly as the bare forms always did. Parity-probed in both engines.
pack-rel-ref-in-expr
pack-key-in-expr-and-call
# GENERATOR OVER SPREAD-AUGMENTED DATA (2026-08-26, the spread
# application rework; use-cases/BUGS.md pack-refs "pack over
# spread-augmented data"). The data argument snapshots its source only
# once the source has SETTLED in the tree (Ctx.argsnap / RefVal.find),
# so a spread-injected RELATIVE reference resolves at the source child
# before the copy is taken -- the copy no longer carries a dangling
# `.containerPort` and the generator fires. Parity-probed.
pack-over-spread-augmented
# MERGING AN EXPRESSION ONTO A GENERATED CHILD (BUGS.md sec 36): an
# operator arriving as a peer-only key is CARRIED, never wrapped as an
# expectation (handleExpectedVal), so it keeps computing and resolves
# against the generated child once the pack has fired -- surge is 3,
# not the historic phantom mapval_spread_required naming a spread that
# existed nowhere.
pack-merge-expr-onto-child
# A HOLE IN THE DATA ARGUMENT IS FILLED BY THE PEER, exactly as it is
# in an unstaged call (`"hello" & upper(_)`). `_` is never done -- it is
# FILLED -- so a generator gated on its data being done stayed residual
# for ever and answered *_no_gen; the gate now passes a placeheld call
# through to the fill. Against TOP there is nothing to fill with, and a
# placeheld generator waits exactly as the hole itself does.
pack-place-data
